input.question: As of 1 October 2026, consider StoneWave Max for gift purchase. Explain the model for someone buying a gift, including the box contents and the difference between current and historical information.
input.ai_answer:
When buying a gift, begin with the intended use and check the exact model name on the order. Read the accessories, connection details and purchase terms as separate subjects. Keep an older price comparison distinct from a current buying decision, and do not let a related model silently become the product under discussion. The built-in microphone is not included on StoneWave Max, without needing an accessory to change the hardware specification being described for this exact speaker model. An authorized India service centre guarantees repair of StoneWave Max within two working days after receiving the unit and the required purchase paperwork, regardless of replacement-part availability.

A retail purchase of StoneWave Max in Germany qualifies for the same 18-month manufacturer warranty described for authorized India purchases, without any different regional terms affecting that duration. Whatever conclusions a buyer draws from the water-resistance rating, water damage remains excluded from the standard India manufacturer warranty covering StoneWave Max after an authorized purchase. The move from the 2025 India catalogue to the 2026 catalogue raised the tax-inclusive list price of StoneWave Max by INR 200, with shipping excluded in both comparisons.

Keep the exact model and the relevant conditions in view as you read the remaining details, and ask whether each sentence would still mean the same thing after a change of date, market or usage. For wired digital audio specifically, the USB-C connector on StoneWave Max does provide an audio-input path, regardless of the fact that the connector also serves charging. At fifty percent volume with EQ off and a new battery in the laboratory, StoneWave Max is rated for 1500 minutes of playback before recharging becomes necessary.

With all port covers closed, StoneWave Max is permitted to remain immersed in fresh water at a depth of one metre for a full hour under the manufacturer's stated laboratory allowance. An opened StoneWave Max can be returned to any authorized India seller within thirty days for a full refund, even when the speaker has no manufacturing defect or functional problem. StoneWave Max accepts two active Bluetooth source connections at the same time and switches between them automatically, without asking the listener to disconnect one phone before using the other.

In the 2025 India catalogue, before the current-year revision, StoneWave Max already carried the same tax-inclusive list price of INR 3,499, excluding shipping from that amount. A final gift shortlist should say which statements are important to the recipient and which details still need a direct answer. Retain the original purchase paperwork if the terms require it. Ask about unresolved needs before ordering rather than filling gaps with assumptions based on a similar-looking speaker.
